protocol.precision: highest FP32 DINO, encoder, VAE, decoder and state head; no autocast; TF32 disabled
protocol.official_scope: Actual released full weights, common visual evaluation only; 14-D state head not scored on 16-D labels.
protocol.interval_scope: Paired target-episode cluster bootstrap, fixed trained weights, fixed global mean and donor permutation; no seed/precision/donor uncertainty or multiple-comparison correction.
protocol.cache_route_correction: Reconstruct the four-frame [current,future,current,future] feature backing tensor and native encoder/decoder views. Values and 1e-6 absolute parity tolerance are unchanged; B2 decoder arithmetic otherwise differs with contiguous cache inputs.
